description: On the red bedspread in front of you, there’s a small brown cube-shaped box and a smaller white-and-red carton. The right hand reaches forward and down to grasp the small carton as a right-hand object, lifts it up and moves it forward over the brown box, then lowers it onto the top surface and releases, stacking the carton neatly on the box while the left hand stays nearby without touching anything.
